run.prompt: Draw an animated SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle. Make the wheels turn and the pelican pedal. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
run.notes: Honest conditions: generated inside a conversation that already contained repository exploration and earlier geometry experiments (headless-Chrome transform-origin probes and IK angle tables), so harness.context is existing-conversation, not the suggested fresh-conversation comparison condition. The artwork was produced by one Python generation script executed via bash: two-bone IK (thigh 62, shin 66, crank radius 30, forward knee) solves 20 phase samples per 1.6 s pedal revolution for both legs (far leg 180 deg out of phase) and bakes relative thigh/shin/foot rotation deltas into CSS @keyframes; nested groups use transform-box:view-box with transform-origin 0 0 so each segment rotates about its own proximal joint (semantics verified by headless-Chrome probe renders before authoring). Wheels and chainring spin via CSS rotation, pedals counter-rotate to stay level, road dashes and chain dashes run via stroke-dashoffset, clouds drift via translateX, head bobs and tail wiggles on ease-in-out. A prefers-reduced-motion media query disables every animation. The poster was derived automatically from the generated SVG by stripping its style block only, leaving a static rest-pose first frame; the animated artifact itself is unmodified after generation (postProcessing none, source null). Render-checked with headless Chrome: poster frame and a mid-animation frame both show correct pedal tracking and wheel spin. Model identity MiMo-V2.6-Pro is what the harness system reports and is not independently verified, so model.id is null; provider Xiaomi likewise not independently verified. Known defects recorded rather than corrected: chain is an animated dashed stroke, not linked chain geometry; both legs share one screen plane; hips are fixed so the seat post does not react to leg IK; saddle is mostly occluded by the body; cloud loop wraps discontinuously offscreen; feather detail is stylized flat shapes; no audio.
